issue.title: fix(compiler): properly report unresolved dependencies
issue.body:
Fixes #9332

As a bonus it doesn't trigger repeated calls to `getDependenciesMetadata` for providers.

I didn't want to do bigger refactorings in this PR but I'm really not a big fan of how we store resolved dependencies on _both_ a provider metadata (`deps`) and Type / Factory metadata (`diDeps`). Happy to tackle it in another PR if we agree on one place of storing those.

Anyway, what we've got in this PR is improvement over master, so baby steps, baby steps...
